name: China Marine Information Electronics Company Limited
summary: China Marine Information Electronics Company Limited engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electronic defense and information equipment in China and internationally. The company offers underwater defense products used for underwater information detection and countermeasures, acquisition, transmission, system control, and underwater acoustics; dedicated computer products, such as computers, servers, storage devices, and network equipment, as well as module-level products which include hardware, firmware, software, and structures.
